pages.title: Chapter 4: Cold Forging Process
pages.text: §8[Cold Forging Core Flow]$(br2)Cold forging is the process of shaping metal by hammering at room temperature. The process has three main stages: stretching into sheet, processing into shape, and carving final products.

pages.title: §8[Step 1: Stretch Billet to Sheet]
pages.text: Place softened billet on anvil and left-click with stone hammer repeatedly. The billet will be stretched into a metal sheet.$(br2)Action: Hold stone hammer, aim at softened billet on anvil, left-click repeatedly. Progress bar shows forging progress.$(br2)§lNote: There is a 1% chance of forging failure, dropping metal fragments instead of a sheet.
§3Copper Sheet$(br2)Forged from copper billet by hammering on the anvil. An intermediate product for further processing. Silver and gold sheets follow the same process.

pages.title: §8[Step 2: Process the Sheet]
pages.text: Metal sheets need two processing steps to become carveable:$(br2)$(li)Sheet → §4Curve§r: Right-click sheet on anvil with axe$(br)$(li)Curve → §4Slot§r: Right-click curve on anvil with axe$(br2)Curves are for forging axes, slots are for forging blades, carving knives, or further processing into rings, hooks, pins.
§cCopper Curve - Processed from copper sheet, used for forging axes with hammer or further processing into copper slots with axe.
§cCopper Slot - Processed from copper curve, the base for forging blades with hammer, carving knives with chisel, or further processing into rings, hooks, pins.

pages.title: §8[Step 3: Forge and Carve Final Products]
pages.text: Different products use different tools and methods:$(br2)§4Forging (Hammer Left-click):$(br)$(li)Curve + Hammer → §4Axe Head$(br)$(li)Slot + Hammer → §4Sword Blade$(br2)§5Carving (Chisel Left-click):$(br)$(li)Slot + Chisel → §4Primitive Knife$(br)$(li)Metal Pin + Chisel → §4Pin Chestplate

pages.title: Controls Summary
pages.text: §2How to operate:$(br2)$(li)Hammer Left-click - stretch billet into sheet, forge curve→axe, forge slot→blade$(br)$(li)Axe Right-click - sheet→curve, curve→slot, slot→ring→hook→pin$(br)$(li)Chisel Left-click - carve slot→knife, carve metal pin→pin chestplate
